matchups.task: Write a resignation letter plus a one-page two-week transition/handoff plan for a fictional mid-level marketing manager
matchups.why: Everyone eventually has to write one of these, and it's a great test of tone control (professional, no burned bridges) plus real document formatting.

matchups.task: Turn a sample CSV of a month's personal expenses into a one-page budget report PDF with a chart and 3 actionable takeaways
matchups.why: Budget season is coming up and this checks whether a tool can actually produce a real chart-bearing PDF, not just chat about the numbers.

matchups.task: Generate a 5-slide investor pitch deck file for a fictional small coffee-roasting business
matchups.why: Pitch decks are one of the most common 'I need a real file by tomorrow' asks, and slide tools vary wildly in actual exportability.

matchups.task: Write a Python cron script that backs up a local folder to cloud storage and emails a daily summary, with no stubbed-out TODOs
matchups.why: A dev-focused matchup is overdue, and 'does it actually run' is the sharpest honesty test we can apply.

matchups.task: Design a logo plus a mini brand style guide (color palette and font pairing) for a fictional neighborhood coffee shop
matchups.why: First image-generation matchup for the series, and logo work is the single most-requested 'make me a real asset' task.
